alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 22 at 2:34AM EDT until October 22 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 3 feet. * WHERE...Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

alerts.headline: Gale Warning issued October 22 at 2:34AM EDT until October 23 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Cape Cod Bay; Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay
alerts.description: * WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 4 to 6 feet. * WHERE...Cape Cod Bay, Nantucket Sound, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. * WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT Friday. * IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction: Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for hazardous conditions.
